A 50-key waterfront resort on 8.10 acres in Talbot County, Maryland.

Wylder Hotel Tilghman Island sits directly on the Chesapeake Bay in Talbot County, Maryland — an 8.10-acre waterfront parcel with a marina, pool, restaurant and boat bar. Operated under the Wylder Hotels brand, the property is mid-repositioning, with a Small Luxury Hotels affiliation planned for Year 2.

Business plan and capital improvement program.

Capital Improvement Program $3.0M · $52,684 / key
01
Guest room renovation
Full renovation of all 57 guest rooms at $25,000 per key. Four out-of-service keys are returned and three added in the back house, taking the hotel from 50 to 57 — 12.3% more sellable inventory that has never produced revenue.
$1.43M
02
Additional revenue sources
A 25-slip marina built for $250,000 carries almost no operating overhead and contributes roughly $146,000 a year at stabilization — payback inside two years on revenue never previously captured. A reconfigured boat bar and rebuilt three-bedroom house add further sources.
$0.85M
03
Brand affiliation
Operation under the Wylder Hotels brand, with a planned Small Luxury Hotels affiliation in Year 2 distributed through Hilton channels.
SLH · Yr 2

Exterior and interior improvements, contingency and professional fees complete the $3,003,000 program, equal to $52,684 per key across 57 keys. The program is funded by the sponsor outside this financing and is not drawn from loan proceeds.

Wylder Hotel Tilghman Island · Senior Debt Financing MMCC · The TRANCHE Group06

Small Luxury Hotels affiliation and distribution.

Why the Affiliation Matters
Hilton Distribution

SLH member hotels are bookable directly through Hilton.com, the Hilton app and Hilton Honors. The affiliation places the property inside Hilton's reservation and loyalty system rather than leaving it dependent on direct booking and third-party channels, which is the mechanism behind the projected occupancy and rate gain.

An Established Relationship

The sponsor already operates within SLH. Wylder Windham, the sister hotel in the Catskills, is an SLH member and was the first in that market. The application here is an extension of a working relationship rather than a first approach.

American Express Fine Hotels & Resorts

Wylder Windham carries the American Express Fine Hotels & Resorts designation, reached through the SLH platform. The same designation is the plan at Tilghman Island, adding a high-rate corporate and affluent leisure channel on completion.

Affiliation is targeted on completion of the renovation and remains subject to application, inspection, board approval and an executed brand affiliate agreement.

What the Market Trend Supports

Market supply has been unchanged at approximately 404 rooms since 2022, while demand has grown in each of the last two years and reached a ten-year high of 84,017 room nights in 2025. Trailing twelve-month demand through March 2026 is running 5.6% ahead of the prior period. Market RevPAR has compounded at 7.4% a year over the last decade and stands at a record $199. The projections adopt none of this growth: rate and occupancy for the competitive market are held flat at 2025 levels throughout, so the entire RevPAR gain in the plan is attributed to the renovation, the seven added keys and the brand affiliation.

Demand figures are annual room nights for the market set. Supply is average rooms available per day.

Of the $18,679,659 total project cost basis, $12,714,782 has been incurred to date and $5,964,877 remains to be funded, comprising the capital improvement program, reserves, fees and closing costs. The $3,003,000 capital program is funded by the sponsor outside this financing.

Cost Basis

Total project cost basis of $18,679,659 ($327,713 per key on 57 keys) against a $12,600,000 loan. That basis includes $2,000,000 of sponsor cash equity funded outside loan proceeds.

Amortization

Thirty years, fully amortizing from closing with no interest-only period. Principal reduces each month at a 10.789% annual constant, lowering the outstanding balance throughout the term.

Sponsor Support

Completion and cost-overrun guaranty, full carry guaranty through renovation and stabilization, recourse carve-outs and environmental indemnity, and a $10,000,000 minimum net-worth covenant on the guarantor.

The Tilghman Island Inn is the nearest transaction and is reported under contract at $5,200,000. It is a 20-key upper-midscale property configured as condominium units on five acres, with 1,800 SF of meeting space and seven slips. It carries neither the key count, the two food and beverage outlets, the 23-slip marina, the 5,252 SF of event space nor the income base of the subject, and it establishes small-inn pricing on the island rather than resort pricing.

What the Local Set Does Establish

The Tidewater Inn, an 89-key full-service hotel in Easton, is expected to be brought to market in 2026 and reported 2025 occupancy of 48% at a $238 average rate on approximately $950,000 of net operating income. It is the only property in the local set operating at institutional scale, and it does so at a rate 34% below the subject's stabilized projection and without waterfront, marina or resort positioning. The local evidence therefore brackets the subject rather than pricing it: small inns below, and a single larger property operating in a materially different product tier.

The eight resort transactions at left average 44 keys, closely matching the subject at 57, and support a per-key range of $266,000 to $893,000 with a median of $332,000. The estimated as-is value of $368,421 per key sits between that median and the average.
